edits.old: Then one decision record and one flag exist after the retry
edits.new:
Then one decision record and one flag exist after the retry

  Scenario: AC14 Consumed call fails (exception X7)
    Given rwb-source-data, rwb-case, rwb-decision or rwb-access returns a failure answer to a call of the step
    When its trigger arrives
    Then the step writes nothing
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC15 Status change the model does not allow
    Given a status change the model does not allow is requested for the case
    When the operation is taken
    Then the system refuses the change with a problem response of the route operation
    Then no record is written
